hero_subhead: 10% of every Impact Product™ supports a partner nonprofit — tracked openly.

how_steps.title: A product is designated
how_steps.description: The Co.LLab™ marks a specific product as an Impact Product and sets a fixed percentage — currently 10%.

how_steps.title: The allocation is recorded
how_steps.description: Each sale's share is logged to the partner's ledger.

how_steps.title: Totals are public
how_steps.description: Running totals per partner below — no customer details.

how_steps.title: Funds are remitted
how_steps.description: The Co.LLab™ reconciles and sends the allocated amount to each partner directly, on a regular cadence.

how_notice: Full transparency: Stripe doesn't split funds automatically. Unless a partner has its own Stripe Connect account, The Co.LLab™ tracks the 10% and sends it directly. The ledger below shows what's allocated and what's been sent.
products_note: More Impact Products may be added, each clearly marked.
closing_headline: Every founding option directs 10% to a partner nonprofit.
